SHARED-F-2-S143.title: Consent Schema and Data Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S143.description: Define and enforce canonical consent schema including tier definitions, timestamps, user/session linkage, and storage flags. Align Pydantic models with persistence schema to ensure consistent validation across services.

SHARED-F-2-S144.title: Consent Core Logic: Tier Enforcement and Transition Rules
SHARED-F-2-S144.description: Implement core business logic governing Tier 1 vs Tier 2 consent, including upgrade/downgrade rules, default behaviors, and blocking conditions for data persistence when consent is absent or insufficient.

SHARED-F-2-S145.title: Consent De-identification and Summarization Pipeline Hardening
SHARED-F-2-S145.description: Formalize and enforce de-identification (HIPAA Safe Harbor) and summarization pipeline prior to any storage under Tier 1, ensuring no PHI leakage and consistent summarization outputs for downstream use.

SHARED-F-2-S146.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S146.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering consent tier validation, enforcement across services, de-identification behavior, and API contract compliance, aligned with UAT scenarios.
